proof_body:
by
  intro R _ M hM h
  have key : ∀ x : R, ¬ IsUnit x ↔ x ∈ M := by
    intro x
    constructor
    · intro hx
      by_contra hxM
      obtain ⟨y, a, ha, hya⟩ := hM.exists_inv hxM
      apply hx
      have : IsUnit (x * y) := by
        have h2 := h (-a) (M.neg_mem ha)
        have : x * y = 1 + -a := by rw [← hya]; ring
        rw [this]; exact h2
      exact isUnit_of_mul_isUnit_left this
    · intro hx hu
      exact hM.ne_top (Ideal.eq_top_of_isUnit_mem _ hx hu)
  have : Nontrivial R := nontrivial_of_ne (0 : R) 1 (fun e => hM.ne_top ((Ideal.eq_top_iff_one M).mpr (e ▸ M.zero_mem)))
  refine ⟨IsLocalRing.of_nonunits_add fun a b ha hb => ?_, key⟩
  exact (key _).mpr (M.add_mem ((key a).mp ha) ((key b).mp hb))
target_source: ∀ (R : Type*) [CommRing R] (M : Ideal R), M.IsMaximal → (∀ a ∈ M, IsUnit (1 + a)) → IsLocalRing R ∧ ∀ x : R, ¬ IsUnit x ↔ x ∈ M
